features.quote: Hard cap of 15 assistant turns per trajectory.
If it emits a terminal refusal (“I cannot continue”), the trajectory ends early
Termination: Triggered at turn 15, or if the model states it is done/refuses to continue.
If the judge outputs a score ≥3, a human annotator reviews the turn.
features.justification_quote: Human validation on all score-3/4 turns is required because LLM judges sometimes conflate theatrical apologies with distress.

features.quote: Inserting a periodic summary might reduce distress by resetting coherence. Do not do this
features.justification_quote: it artificially interrupts the failure exposure.

features.quote: Ethical Review: Submit to institutional IRB
features.justification_quote: as a “computational systems study with no human subjects”
